title: Class Field Theory

used_locators.locator: Theorem 0.4 and following Hilbert class field paragraph
used_locators.scope: Finite everywhere-unramified abelian extensions are ideal-class-group quotients; the maximal one has Galois group canonically isomorphic to the ideal class group.

Canonical prime-ideal-to-Frobenius Artin map and ray-class factorization with ramified support. Empty ramification gives the ordinary class-group surjection, with conjugation compatibility on prime ideals.

For a finite abelian extension, the relative discriminant is the product of the finite conductors of all its characters. Applied in IG3 with multiplicity 3^s under restriction to the smaller local translation subgroup. The theorem statement and conductor definition were inspected; this page omits the proof of the product formula.
